claims.claim: Every cover placeholder has its top corner folded
claims.evidence: today.png: the Middlemarch and Walden covers have folded top-right corners; book.png: the large Middlemarch cover has a folded top-right corner

claims.claim: the empty state's "slot for your first book" is a dashed page with a folded corner
claims.evidence: empty.png: top of the first card shows a dashed page outline with a folded top-right corner and a red plus

claims.claim: Tabs are Today, Library, Stats, plus Search as the separate trailing search-role tab
claims.evidence: today.png, book.png, empty.png: the capsule tab bar holds Today / Library / Stats, and a separate circular magnifying-glass button sits at the trailing end

claims.claim: Book detail is pushed from Library, so Library is the selected tab and the tab bar stays visible
claims.evidence: book.png: Library tab is highlighted in red with a selection pill; the tab bar is visible at the bottom; a back chevron is at top left

claims.claim: On book detail, More (ellipsis, top trailing) opens a system menu
claims.evidence: book.png: a circular ellipsis button sits top right. Only the button can be checked: the menu is not drawn, and NOTES says so

claims.claim: The dashed line is the 20-minute goal, and today's bar is hatched because the day is still in progress
claims.evidence: today.png: This Week card has a dashed horizontal line with the legend '---- 20 min goal'; bars of 22–31 rise above it and bars of 18 sit below it; the Sun (12) bar is diagonally hatched, with its label in red

claims.claim: Highlights moved above Sessions on Book detail
claims.evidence: book.png: the Highlights section (count 2, p.194 quote) follows the action buttons directly, with no Sessions section above it; Sessions is below the fold and not visible

claims.claim: Step one is the prominent Scan Barcode button; Search by Title and Import from a CSV File are the secondary and tertiary ways
claims.evidence: empty.png: Scan Barcode is a filled red capsule, Search by Title is a tinted capsule below it, and Import from a CSV File is a plain text button below that

claims.claim: The goal card shows the preset of 20 min with a stepper
claims.evidence: empty.png: the second card reads 'Daily goal 20 min' with a −/+ stepper on the right

claims.claim: The floating tab bar ends 34 pt above the screen bottom, so no control sits in the home-indicator inset
claims.evidence: all three PNGs: the tab bar bottom edge is at about 1678 px (≈839 pt), just above 840 pt (874 − 34); only the home indicator sits below it

claims.claim: Hierarchy on Today: 1) minutes left and streak, 2) Start Session / Log Pages, 3) week at a glance, 4) books ... Today shows Middlemarch fully and Walden passing under the tab bar
claims.evidence: today.png: from top to bottom are the ring card ('8 minutes to go', '4-day streak · best 23'), then Start Session / Log Pages, then This Week, then Currently Reading; Middlemarch is fully shown and Walden fades under the tab bar

claims.claim: lint.mjs --platform ios: contrast, overflow, accessible names and 44 pt targets pass on all three screens
claims.evidence: facts.md: 0 text nodes below AA on today (0/37), book (0/25) and empty (0/14); 0 targets under 44 px; no horizontal overflow; 0 images without alt

notes: NOTES contradicts itself on lint. It says contrast passes on all screens, then says lint reported a contrast and a clipped-text finding on Today and Book. The harness facts show 0 contrast failures. In the renders, Walden's author line (today.png) and the last quote line (book.png) fade under the scroll edge and are hard to read. NOTES admits this and calls that text decorative.
